- **设计风格 (Overall Aesthetic)：**\
  **暗黑空间与光影美学 (Dark Space & Light Art)**。摒弃繁杂背景，利用强烈的聚光灯、星环发光或地平线光晕营造深邃的“失重悬浮感”与“无限空间感”，突出产品的几何雕塑感与未来科技属性。

- **排版布局 (Layout & Typography)：**\
  **严格的中轴对称式构图 (Vertical Symmetry)**。采用“上文下图”结构：顶部居中排布无衬线体（Sans-serif）主副标题，字号对比强烈；画面中下部作为核心视觉区，产品呈悬浮或仰视姿态拔地而起。留黑（负空间）极大，视线高度聚焦于产品主体与核心光影。

- **色调配色 (Color Palette & Tone)：**\
  整体基调为**深邃冷峻的曜石黑/深空灰 (Obsidian Black/Space Grey)**。以高对比度的\*\*冷色发光（如冰川蓝、霓虹青）**或**高饱和暖光（日落金、晨曦橙）\*\*作为环境渲染与产品轮廓光（Rim Light），形成极致的明暗冲突（Chiaroscuro），极具电影级的高级质感与能量爆发感。

metadata.content:
- **整体设计风格 (Overall Aesthetic)：**\
  **高阶极简与建筑空间美学 (Advanced Minimalism & Architectural Space)**。摒弃了传统直播间繁杂的背景与装饰，采用类似现代高端美术馆或Apple Store的陈列逻辑。大量使用干净的几何线条（如圆柱体展台、巨大的圆形顶灯、利落的平直线条），强调材质的哑光质感与空间的呼吸感，传递出专业、纯粹、克制的高端科技品牌调性。

- **空间布局与排版 (Spatial Layout & Composition)：**\
  **严格的中轴对称式构图 (Strict Central Axis Symmetry)**。

  - **视觉锚点：** 画面以绝对居中的立柱发光带和正前方的几何展台构成强烈的中心视觉锚点，确保直播时的焦点完全锁定在主播与核心产品上。

  - **两侧留白：** 左右两侧墙面采用大面积留白（负空间），仅辅以对称的极简悬浮一字隔板，形成视觉上的平衡与延伸。

  - **纵深层级：** 通过“顶部环形灯带 - 背景发光立柱 - 前景立体展台”构建出清晰的Z轴空间景深，使平面的直播画面具有建筑级的立体感。

- **色调与光影配色 (Color Palette & Lighting Tone)：**\
  **低饱和暖调中性色与漫反射光影 (Low-saturation Warm Neutrals & Diffuse Lighting)**。

  - **色彩基调：** 整体摒弃了科技行业常见的暗黑或高饱和霓虹色，转而采用大面积的**暖灰色 (Warm Grey)、米白色 (Off-White) 与砂岩色 (Sandstone)**。这种低饱和的单色调（Monochromatic）营造出一种治愈、高级且不喧宾夺主的背景氛围。

  - **光影设计：** 核心采用**无主灯设计的漫反射环境光 (Ambient Diffuse Light)**。利用背景的隐藏式发光带（柔和的奶油暖光）和顶部的洗墙灯，消除了生硬的物理阴影。品牌标识与核心区域采用自发光设计，以光线代替实体制轮廓，呈现出轻盈的未来科技质感。

第一步：策划与分镜设计

创意主题：**「黑白之间，自有秩序」**。让一道光成为贯穿全片的视觉线索：从黑色鼠标的轮廓出发，进入滚轮与壳体细节，再由白色鼠标接住光线，最终汇成黑白双款的完整展示。15秒内完成“引起好奇—看清细节—记住产品”的视觉叙事。

基于图片，重点呈现**黑白双色、圆润低矮轮廓、简洁按键分区、细密滚轮纹理**。整体采用高端微距产品摄影与黑白极简布景；功能文案仅围绕可见设计，不加入未经确认的静音、续航或连接性能。

| 镜头序号(1-9) | 景别与运镜 | 画面详细描述 | 时长(总计15秒) | 旁白/音效 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 近景／低机位缓推 | 深炭灰背景中，黑色鼠标静置于同色台面，前端朝画面左下、尾部朝右上。一道窄长柔光沿顶部圆弧掠过，逐渐显露低矮的圆润外形与壳体接缝；保持完整原型，无发光结构。 | 1.5秒（0–1.5秒） | 低频氛围音渐入，轻微空气掠过声。 |
| 2 | 微距特写／沿中轴短距离推进 | 靠近黑色鼠标前部，黑色滚轮成为视觉中心。侧上方柔光照出滚轮的细密横向齿纹、深色轮槽与前后相接的按键分割线，背景自然虚化。鼠标静止，滚轮不变形。 | 1.5秒（1.5–3秒） | 一次清脆、轻量的电子节拍，与滚轮细节亮起同步。 |
| 3 | 大特写／贴近侧缘横移 | 镜头沿黑色鼠标可见侧面的上壳与下壳接缝滑动，掠过前端圆角。细长高光依附真实壳体曲面，展示均匀缝隙及深灰黑色表面的柔和反光。构图让接缝形成左下至右上的斜线。 | 1.5秒（3–4.5秒） | 细腻的滑动拟音，氛围音乐节奏开始建立。 |
| 4 | 大特写／匹配剪辑后轻拉远 | 承接上一镜斜线位置，切换为白色鼠标同一侧缘。背景同步变成浅灰白，白色上壳、浅灰接缝与圆润下壳依次显现。通过剪辑完成黑白切换，不表现外壳变色。 | 1.5秒（4.5–6秒） | 明亮短音落点，衔接轻柔的高频空气声。 |
| 5 | 特写至中近景／小幅弧线环绕 | 白色鼠标完整出现在浅灰台面，保持前左、后右的三分之四视角。镜头小幅环绕，展示左右按键、浅银白色齿纹滚轮、饱满尾部和低矮侧廓。光影随观察角度自然变化，产品稳固落在台面上。 | 2秒（6–8秒） | 旁白：“简于形。”音乐加入简洁脉冲节拍。 |
| 6 | 微距特写／微俯视与焦点转移 | 聚焦白色鼠标前部，先让浅银白色滚轮纹理清晰，再将焦点转移到轮槽旁的白色按键边缘。保留原图中的中央分割线与壳体比例，不增加按键、灯光或标识。 | 1.5秒（8–9.5秒） | 两个轻微节奏音对应焦点转换；声音作为配乐，不暗示实际按键声。 |
| 7 | 双产品中景／斜俯视缓降 | 黑白双款首次同框：白色位于左侧浅色区域，黑色位于右侧深色区域，两只鼠标均前端朝左下。台面明暗分界呼应前面接缝的斜线，形成图形上的延续；产品大小一致，互不遮挡。 | 2秒（9.5–11.5秒） | 旁白：“精于细节。”低频与明亮音色汇合。 |
| 8 | 双产品近景／横向滑轨 | 黑白双款保持静止，镜头低角度横移，借视差呈现两只鼠标相同的圆弧轮廓、前缘和滚轮。一道宽柔光同时扫过两款表面，背景从明暗分区过渡为均匀浅灰。 | 1.5秒（11.5–13秒） | 一次短促柔和的上扬转场声，音乐向收束推进。 |

Arrange exactly nine rectangular panels in three equal columns and three equal rows, read left to right and top to bottom. Every panel must have a true 16:9 composition. Use a 16:9 overall canvas with edge-to-edge equal cells and hairline internal dividers, no outer border, no extra caption strips. Target 5760 x 3240 pixels if supported.

Creative concept: “Order Between Black and White.” Build a coherent visual progression from a dark silhouette, through precise surface details, into a bright white reveal, and finally a balanced composition of both color variants. Light is the connecting visual motif. Each panel is one representative cinematic keyframe from a distinct shot, not a collage of multiple moments.

PRODUCT IDENTITY:
Reproduce the exact two mouse variants shown in the reference: one white mouse and one charcoal-black mouse, both sharing the same geometry and proportions. Preserve the low rounded body, gently domed top, broad curved rear, rounded front, two main click surfaces divided by the reference center seam, a single recessed ridged scroll wheel near the front, and the narrow seam between the upper shell and lower body. Follow the exact length and placement of the center seam visible in the reference; do not extend it across the entire rear shell. The white variant has a pale silver-white ridged wheel. The black variant has a dark ridged wheel. Match the reference surface finish, with soft controlled reflections and no exaggerated gloss.

In all full-product views, the front and scroll-wheel end point toward the lower left, and the rounded rear points toward the upper right, matching the reference photograph. Keep both variants identical in size and shape. Products rest naturally on a surface with believable contact shadows. Use only viewpoints supported by the visible top and side geometry in the reference.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Luxury consumer electronics advertising, restrained monochrome palette, sculptural studio lighting, realistic product photography, precise macro detail, clean negative space, subtle tonal gradients, controlled highlights, physically plausible shadows, and consistent neutral color grading. Maintain sharp product silhouettes. Use shallow depth of field for macro panels and sufficient depth of field for complete product views. The connecting light must read as an external studio reflection on the shell, never as an illuminated strip built into the mouse.

PANEL 1 — TOP LEFT — 0.0–1.5 seconds:
A close, low three-quarter view of the black mouse resting on a charcoal surface against a charcoal background. Front points lower left, rear upper right. A narrow soft reflection reveals the curved top and a small portion of the shell seam, while much of the body remains in shadow. The outline is recognizable and faithful to the reference. Frame the moment of initial reveal, suggesting a slow camera push-in.

PANEL 2 — TOP CENTER — 1.5–3.0 seconds:
An extreme macro view of the black mouse scroll wheel and the immediately surrounding click surfaces, photographed from slightly above the front. Reveal the fine transverse wheel ridges, recessed wheel opening, and adjoining center seam. Use a narrow soft highlight and dark tonal separation. The wheel and shell remain physically intact and stationary.

PANEL 3 — TOP RIGHT — 3.0–4.5 seconds:
An extreme close-up of the black mouse side seam near the rounded front corner. The actual shell seam runs diagonally from lower left toward upper right. A delicate reflected highlight describes the rounded top shell above the darker lower body. Suggest a lateral macro tracking shot. Preserve the exact shell construction with no added controls or decorative parts.

PANEL 4 — MIDDLE LEFT — 4.5–6.0 seconds:
A match-cut composition of the same visible side seam and front corner on the white mouse. Match the diagonal line placement and camera angle of Panel 3. Change the environment to soft off-white and pale gray. Show the white upper shell, subtle gray seam, and softly rounded lower body. This is a separate white product photographed in a separate shot, with no material transformation effect.

PANEL 5 — MIDDLE CENTER — 6.0–8.0 seconds:
A complete three-quarter hero view of the white mouse on a pale gray studio surface. Front lower left, rear upper right. Clearly show both click surfaces, the pale silver-white ridged scroll wheel, gently domed rear, and low curved side profile. Use a broad softbox reflection, a clean contact shadow, and generous negative space. Choose a frame suggesting a restrained camera orbit around the stationary product.

PANEL 6 — MIDDLE RIGHT — 8.0–9.5 seconds:
A slightly overhead macro of the white mouse front section. Place the ridged scroll wheel and the adjacent white click-surface edge within the same composition. Render the near edge beside the wheel crisply, with the farther wheel ridges becoming gently softer, suggesting the endpoint of a subtle focus pull. Maintain the exact reference wheel opening, center seam, and body proportions.

PANEL 7 — BOTTOM LEFT — 9.5–11.5 seconds:
A balanced elevated three-quarter view of both mice, fully visible and separated by a clear gap. White mouse on the left, black mouse on the right; both fronts point lower left. The studio surface has a flat diagonal pale-to-charcoal tonal division between the products, visually echoing the seam direction in Panels 3 and 4. This division is a graphic lighting or backdrop treatment, not a raised platform. Keep both products equally scaled and clearly readable.

PANEL 8 — BOTTOM CENTER — 11.5–13.0 seconds:
A closer, lower three-quarter view of both mice, white left and black right, arranged with a slight depth offset so neither product obscures the other’s scroll wheel or front edge. A broad soft studio reflection touches both curved shells simultaneously. The background is now nearly uniform light gray. Suggest lateral camera movement through perspective and composition, with crisp stationary products and no motion blur.

PANEL 9 — BOTTOM RIGHT — 13.0–15.0 seconds:
The final clean product hero composition, closely matching the supplied reference: complete white mouse on the left, complete black mouse on the right, both front ends pointing lower left and rounded rear ends pointing upper right. Equal product scale, balanced spacing, soft off-white background, subtle contact shadows, and sharp visible scroll-wheel details. Leave generous clear space above the products for a tagline to be added later. Render no tagline or other text in the image.

CONTINUITY AND EXCLUSIONS:
Preserve the same product identity across all nine panels. Only the specified two color variants may appear. Do not redesign the mouse, alter its proportions, enlarge the scroll wheel, or invent unseen technical details. No extra buttons, side buttons, logos, branding, cables, charging ports, RGB lighting, glowing seams, transparent shells, internal components, exploded views, floating products, hands, computers, decorative props, or metallic body finishes. No text, letters, panel numbers, timestamps, watermarks, or interface elements. Exactly nine panels with nine distinct shot compositions, maintaining the specified reading order and consistent premium photographic treatment.

① 两条分支相互独立：分支 A 用教学视频做动作与时间参考，分支 B 用深度动作捕捉视频；克隆后替换对应的人物图和参考视频。
② 替换素材后选中人物图与参考视频重新生成视频；人物身份外观保持一致，动作按参考视频完整复刻、不镜像不删减。

nodes.title: 替换舞蹈参考视频 A · 教学
成果 · 舞蹈复刻视频 A

metadata.prompt:
使用图片1 中的人物作为唯一主角，使用视频1 作为动作与时间参考，生成完整的舞蹈视频。

人物外观：
严格保持图片1 中人物的身份与外观，包括脸部特征、发型、发色、体型、身体比例、肤色、服装和配饰。整段视频中人物外观保持一致，面部清晰稳定，服装不发生变化。
参考视频A中的白模或灰度深度信息仅用于指导姿势、动作和空间位置；最终画面呈现参考图片B中人物的真实外观与服装。

舞蹈动作：
完整复刻参考视频1 中舞蹈教学者的整套动作，严格遵循原视频的动作顺序、节奏、停顿时长、身体朝向、动作幅度、重心变化和移动路线。
按照原视频时间轴同步完成每一个动作，准确还原手臂与手部姿势、抬腿与踏步、屈膝、转身、身体倾斜及定格动作。保持原视频的左右方向，不进行镜像翻转。
保留所有教学停顿、重复动作和动作之间的衔接，不自行编舞、不添加或遗漏动作，不以循环片段替代完整舞蹈。人物从参考视频的起始姿势开始，以对应的结束姿势结束。

动作与身体：
身体结构和关节运动符合人体规律，四肢比例稳定，动作连贯自然。双脚接地可靠，踏步、落脚和重心转换准确协调，无滑步、漂浮或肢体穿模。
在动作全过程中保持人物身份与面部特征稳定，头部转动、视线方向和身体朝向跟随参考视频。头发和衣物随动作自然运动。

构图与镜头：
人物作为唯一舞者，在舞台中央沿参考视频的路线完成动作。使用固定机位、全身构图，完整展示头部、双手和双脚，为抬臂、抬腿及横向移动保留足够空间。
保持与参考视频一致的拍摄角度，镜头稳定，不切镜、不推拉、不环绕。背景简洁，光照稳定，无其他人物或遮挡舞蹈动作的物体。

时长与成片：
视频时长与视频1 保持一致，动作起止时间与原视频同步。画面清晰，人物外观一致，动作平滑，重点呈现完整、准确的舞蹈复刻。
